title: Visual Effects+
description: Biome based dynamic and colored fog with custom particles and weather!
body:
###  Read carefully!

---

![vfx+logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2728ce87d7217708f74cbd7059242406a7a0a137_0.webp)

**Visual Effects+ is a resource pack that overhauls Minecraft by reworking every single biome in the game, changing vanilla particles, adding a bunch of new ones, introducing dynamic and colorful fog, a new weather system, and much more.**

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This resource pack takes a lot of time and effort to make. If you’d like to support its development, consider buying me a coffee.
[![ko-fi](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3f7c6abf6d108add23d7bef359a0275e199e2238_0.webp)](https://ko-fi.com/dosya06)

## Compatibility:

**Resource pack compatibility:**

You can add any resource pack you want and get unique experience with VFX+ resource pack!

**Shader compatibility:**

VFX+ isn't compatible with any shader that replaces fog or turns off particles.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### RECOMMENDED SETTINGS

---

<details>
<summary> Recommended settings </summary>

**1. Pack should be on top!**
![pack on top](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8016690dc6263dead72befeee32c67d3eeb1761_0.webp)

Your pack should be always on top to prevent any polytone related issues.

**2. Turn off fog occlusion!**
![fog occlusion](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/572df5ee3f99aba66c5a46b4881fd406b16c0254.jpeg)

You can find this option in **"Performance"** tab.

**For low-end PC left it turned on**

**Recommended render distance is 12 - 16 chunks, but you can modify this value as you want**


</details>

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

"This resource pack is in **early development** and alot of things might change by release time.

Also this pack might have bugs or any other issues. **If something went wrong you can state about it on [Visual Effects+ discord server](https://discord.gg/wcVM9VB9V6).**
